Name: Format
Description: Specifies the file format for the exported output. Choose the format that best fits your workflow or target application.

Flubs.Name: GaeaRaw
Flubs.Description: Exports the data in Gaea's native RAW format, preserving full precision and compatibility with Gaea.

Flubs.Name: HalfRaw
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as 16-bit half-precision RAW, balancing file size and detail.

Flubs.Name: HalfRaw16
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as 16-bit half-precision RAW with explicit 16-bit formatting.

Flubs.Name: UshortRaw
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as unsigned short (16-bit) RAW, suitable for many terrain and 3D applications.

Flubs.Name: UshortRaw16
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as unsigned short (16-bit) RAW with explicit 16-bit formatting.

Flubs.Name: FloatRaw
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as 32-bit floating point RAW, providing maximum precision for advanced workflows.

Flubs.Name: FloatRaw32
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as 32-bit floating point RAW with explicit 32-bit formatting.

Flubs.Name: JPEG
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as a JPEG image, using lossy compression for reduced file size and broad compatibility.

Flubs.Name: PNG8
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as an 8-bit PNG image, suitable for masks and lightweight outputs.

Flubs.Name: PNG16
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as a 16-bit PNG image, preserving more detail for heightfields and masks.

Flubs.Name: PNG64
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as a 64-bit PNG image, supporting high dynamic range and advanced workflows.

Flubs.Name: TIFF8
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as an 8-bit TIFF image, commonly used for masks and simple outputs.

Flubs.Name: TIFF16
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as a 16-bit TIFF image, suitable for high-quality heightfields and masks.

Flubs.Name: TIFF32
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as a 32-bit TIFF image, supporting high dynamic range and scientific workflows.

Flubs.Name: EXR
Flubs.Description: Exports the data as an OpenEXR image, ideal for high dynamic range and professional VFX pipelines.

Name: Location
Description: Specifies where the exported file will be saved.

Flubs.Name: BuildFolder
Flubs.Description: Exports the file to the project's build/output folder.

Flubs.Name: Custom
Flubs.Description: Allows you to specify a custom folder for the exported file.

Flubs.Name: Explicit
Flubs.Description: Exports the file to an explicitly defined path, overriding other location settings.

Name: Output Path
Description: Defines the full file path or directory where the exported file will be saved.

Name: If File Exists
Description: Determines what happens if a file with the same name already exists at the export location.

Flubs.Name: Overwrite
Flubs.Description: Replaces the existing file with the new export.

Flubs.Name: Increment
Flubs.Description: Automatically increments the filename to avoid overwriting existing files.

Name: Information
Description: Displays additional information or metadata about the export process or output file.

Name: Prepare for Bridge
Description: Prepares the exported file for use with the Bridge system, enabling compatibility with external tools or workflows.

Name: Information Houdini
Description: Displays or stores metadata related to Houdini integration, such as file attributes or export status.
